# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Family:** [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking young woman. Despite her ethereal appearance, she is also described as golden and fair when dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant is known for her lively disposition. She is full of fun, mischief, and a penchant for playing pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full to the brim of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's alongside her friend [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During a spring walk through the woods, Priscilla explored back lanes with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), ultimately discovering Hester Gray's forgotten garden. Later, Priscilla unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) accompanied by the author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P0](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0000), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who originally bonded during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They share leisure time enjoying nature, such as joining a woods walk with other friends to explore hidden pools and Hester Gray's forgotten garden. Priscilla also brings distinguished guests to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), unexpectedly arriving with author Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), +15 more_

- Friend of — intimate Academy friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), +5 more</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of the famous author Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). She travels around the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) alongside her aunt as a companion, bringing Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for an unexpected but delightful visit with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), +5 more_
